title: Maintaining Proper Drain Pipe Slope for Effective Flow
description: Maintaining correct slope on horizontal drainage lines is essential for long-term system reliability. If a pipe lacks adequate pitch, liquid moves too slowly, leaving solid waste behind to form stubborn blockages. Over time, inadequate pipe support or loosened hangers cause lines to sag, creating low spots known as bellies where standing water accumulates. Routine preventive maintenance includes checking exposed pipe runs with a torpedo level and ensuring hangers are spaced according to local code requirements. Correcting improper slope early prevents costly back-ups and extends the lifespan of the DWV system.
